children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may test resistance at $6.88-1/2 per bushel, as it has stabilised around support at $6.84-1/4.
A retracement analysis on the uptrend from $6.70-3/4 reveals this 61.8% level as a key support, which has stopped the fall and triggered a bounce.
Resistance is at $6.88-1/2, a break above which may lead to a gain to $6.92-3/4, while a break below $6.84-1/4 may open the way toward $6.79.
On the daily chart, the bounce looks like a pullback toward a rising trendline. A bearish engulfing pattern formed between Tuesday and Wednesday, suggesting a further drop on Thursday.
Based on the reading, the bounce on the hourly chart is likely to be weak.
